spanish: Y fue cien talento de la plata para fundir las basas de lo santo y las basas del velo; cien basas a cien del talento, talento a la basa.
grammarChanges: 'parójet' -> 'velo': הַפָּרֹכֶת is a common noun (veil/curtain) and must be translated, not transliterated; article changed from 'la' to 'del' to match the masculine Spanish noun.
'del santo' -> 'de lo santo': used the neuter article 'lo' so הַקֹּדֶשׁ reads as the holy place/thing, not a person ('el santo' = a saint).
'a cien el talento' -> 'a cien del talento': changed 'el' to the contraction 'del' to mark the construct לִמְאַת הַכִּכָּר ('for the hundred of the talent').
readerNote: Chose 'de lo santo' (neuter) over 'del santo' so הַקֹּדֶשׁ stays the holy place/thing rather than a person, per the auditor warn.
